idea-plugin.name: Path Reference (Path:Line)
idea-plugin.description:
English

Copy a code reference in the form @path/to/File.php:42 or @path/to/File.php:42-57, using a path relative to the project root.

Select a block of code and invoke Copy Path with Line Numbers (default shortcut: Alt+C, or right-click in the editor). With no selection, the caret line is used.

Unlike the built-in Copy Reference, this action always produces a path + line reference, regardless of what is under the caret, and supports multi-line selections and multiple carets.

Settings are available under Settings | Tools | Path Reference (also reachable from Tools | Path Reference Settings…): path style (project root, content root, absolute), a configurable prefix such as @ or #, the separator between the path and the line number, the line-range separator, Markdown backticks, and an optional fenced code block.

The user interface is bilingual: English on an English IDE, Chinese on a Chinese IDE (the strings follow the IDE language pack).

License: Apache-2.0

中文

把选中的代码复制成「开头符号 + 项目相对路径 + 行号」的引用，例如 @app/Services/UserService.php:42 或 @app/Services/UserService.php:42-57。

选中若干行后按 Alt+C（或右键菜单 复制路径和行号）即可复制； 没有选中内容时使用光标所在行。支持多光标、多选区和 Project 视图里的文件。

和 IDE 自带的 Copy Reference 不同，不管光标停在类名还是方法名上， 这里永远输出「路径 + 行号」，并且多行选区会给出起止行范围。

设置位置：Settings | Tools | 路径引用（也可从菜单 Tools | 路径引用设置… 打开），可配置：路径风格（项目根目录 / 内容根目录 / 绝对路径）、开头符号（默认 @，可改成 # 或留空）、 路径与行号之间的分隔符（默认 :，可改成 # 等）、 行号范围分隔符（默认 -）、Markdown 反引号，以及可选的代码块。

界面文案跟随 IDE 语言：中文 IDE 显示中文，英文 IDE 显示英文。

License: Apache-2.0
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.4.1: Paths are now relative even when the project root and the file belong to different file systems or reach the project through a symlink/alias (Remote Development, WSL); files outside the project directory fall back to the content root instead of an absolute path.
  • 1.4.0: Configurable separator between the path and the line number (default :, e.g. #); bilingual plugin description.
  • 1.3.1: Fixed the settings page name showing a raw localization key and placed the page in the Tools group.
  • 1.3.0: The UI is now localized and follows the IDE language (English / 中文).
  • 1.2.0: Settings entry in the Tools menu.
  • 1.1.0: Configurable prefix (default @), default shortcut changed to Alt+C.
  • 1.0.0: Initial version. Project-relative path with caret line or selection range.
